before: An upright shape was cut at its extent and at a negative effect extent, and a press on geometry past its box went to the text.
after: An upright shape paints its whole geometry and outline, unless a layout region cuts into its box, and a press on the painted part past its box selects it.
reason: Only the shape projection, the paint clip, and pointer hit testing change. Source XML, shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
